page_title: VER 1-0 FIO | Verona v Fiorentina 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Marco Di Bello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

90+5' 1 - 0 Antoine Bernede (Verona) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. David de Gea is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
90+3' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 43:57.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
90' The referee blows his whistle as Dodo (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in his challenge.
89' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Lorenzo Montipo.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) was quite harsh and Marco Di Bello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Ondrej Duda (Verona) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
86' Ondrej Duda (Verona) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
85' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Maat Caprini, but Lorenzo Montipo displays great awareness to stop him.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Maat Caprini (Fiorentina) is coming onto the pitch as Nicolo Zaniolo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) dribbles into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
82' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Daniel Mosquera, who fails to shoot.
80' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
79' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
77' Substitution. Davide Faraoni makes his way off the pitch and Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) comes on as his replacement.
77' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Amin Sarr will be replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
76' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 15:5.
73' The substitution has been made. Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) has replaced Luca Ranieri.
72' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Cher Ndour replaces him.
71' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Bernede (Verona) replacing Dailon Rocha Livramento.
70' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
69' Ondrej Duda plays a short lofted pass to Davide Faraoni (Verona), whose header from the centre of the box drifts well past the left post.
67' No one likes to see incidents like this. Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is taken from the field on a stretcher after what looked like a head injury and is replaced by Nicolo Fagioli.
67' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Rolando Mandragora and he is replaced by Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).
65' It doesn’t look good for Moise Kean (Fiorentina); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
64' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
64' Amin Sarr (Verona) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
61' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) passes the ball onto Lucas Beltran, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
60' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) wastes a big opportunity. He shoots from the free kick just outside the box, but his poor effort goes well over the crossbar.
58' Fiorentina are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
58' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
58' Diego Coppola (Verona) makes a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
55' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Di Bello had an easy-decision to make.
50' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

48' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) gets to a rebound and attempts to score with a header. David de Gea is in the right place at the right time and keeps out the effort which was heading towards the middle of the target.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Flag goes up against Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

42' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Moise Kean (Fiorentina) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
40' Ondrej Duda (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Marco Di Bello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
38' Having seen unsporting behavior, Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Paolo Zanetti (Verona) is the recipient.
38' Fiorentina get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
37' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
34' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
32' The ball goes behind for a corner. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' Foul! Ondrej Duda (Verona) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
31' Ondrej Duda (Verona) commits a rough foul. Marco Di Bello stops the game and makes a call.

27' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
24' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
24' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
23' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' Amin Sarr (Verona) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
22' Dodo (Fiorentina) sprays a pass out to Lucas Beltran, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
20' Lorenzo Montipo makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) after a cross from the side.
18' Good defending. Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) tries to find Moise Kean inside the box, but the pass is cut out.

18' Fiorentina slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
15' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
11' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
7' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
5' Dangerous play by Diego Coppola (Verona). Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.

4' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the right side of the goal, Lorenzo Montipo didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
3' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
1' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.

The players are on the pitch and Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
